title: Takaful Claims Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake transforms Takaful claims processing — AI parses 15,000 claim documents, ML scores fraud risk, anomaly detection catches patterns, and Cortex Complete generates investigation summaries for adjusters

talking_points: Fifteen thousand claims processed this quarter — RM 47 million currently under investigation.
Two hundred eighty-four claims flagged as fraudulent — 1.9% fraud detection rate.
Average processing time reduced to 72 hours from claim submission to resolution.
tabs.call_out: 284 fraudulent claims caught — RM 47M under investigation

transition.line: Let's examine how AI scores fraud risk on incoming claims.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION scores every claim — top 284 flagged for investigation.
Claim #TK-8847: duplicate medical receipts from two different clinics for same treatment.
AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT caught the inconsistency — dates match but provider details differ.
tabs.call_out: AI catches what manual review misses — duplicate receipts across providers

transition.line: Individual fraud is one thing. Let's look for systematic patterns.

talking_points: ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flags 4 providers with claims volume 3x above normal.
Provider KL-CLINIC-089: 340% spike in physiotherapy claims over 6 weeks.
Cross-referencing policyholders reveals 12 claims from same household across 3 providers.
tabs.call_out: 4 providers anomalous — potential syndicated fraud ring

transition.line: Now let the CEO ask the system for the full picture.

talking_points: Dato' Hj. Ibrahim asks: 'What is the total value of claims flagged as fraudulent this quarter?'
Cortex Analyst returns: RM 12.4M across 284 claims — 26% of total under investigation.
Switch to advisory: 'Summarize the investigation findings for Claim TK-8847' — generates report.
show: Switch to advisory for investigation summary
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: claims analytics + investigation advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake, no external ML platform needed.

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, five AWS services in the dual-build.
AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT replaces Textract. ML.CLASSIFICATION replaces SageMaker models.
Malaysia's Takaful industry: RM 35B in contributions. This processes 15,000 claims, 50,000 participants.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native ML, no external model training needed

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Takaful intelligence.
